title: Economic Substance Behind Texas Political Anti-ESG Sanctions
authors: Shivaram Rajgopal; Anup Srivastava; Rong Zhao
eligible_reason: No staggered binary panel design. Comparisons of Texas-banned ESG funds vs size-matched funds (mean tests, factor-model regressions with tx x factor and tx x period interactions around the single August 2022 Texas directive) and of red- vs blue-state pension fund holdings.
design_notes: SAS (data construction, WRDS remote access) and Stata (Tables 2, 4B, 5B: reg of daily returns on factors and tx/period interactions, clustered by fund).
data_files_note: Readme.docx: licensed CRSP mutual fund, Compustat, Fama-French, SEC Analytics data not shared; hand-collected lists described as shared publicly but no data files are in the package (only .sas, .do, logs, readme).
data_provenance_note: No data files in the package.
screener_notes: Not a staggered DiD; single policy date.
